headline: HOU @ DET matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is HOU 3.81 at DET 4.56, with a projected total of 8.37. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward DET: HOU moved -0.28 runs while DET moved +0.31, changing the projected margin by -0.59 runs. NRFI probability rose +7.1%, so the first-inning read became more pitcher-friendly early. Pitching context: Troy Melton has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 1.8 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Isaac Paredes, Kevin McGonigle, Yordan Alvarez, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags James Outman, Brice Matthews because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
